program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 12.0, 24.0),     # front CS NMOS: high gm/Id -> max gm per uA, low Vgs
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "I1":    (14e-6, 6e-6, 18e-6),   # core branch current
    "Rf":    (330e3, 260e3, 450e3),  # feedback resistor (sets Zt and noise)
    "gmid2": (8.0, 5.0, 14.0),       # PMOS mirror (load / follower source / diode)
    "L2":    (0.5, 0.3, 2.0),
    "gmid3": (14.0, 8.0, 18.0),      # PMOS follower
    "L3":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "I3":    (7e-6, 3e-6, 10e-6),    # follower current
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Ib = 1.5e-6
    I1, I3, Rf = p["I1"], p["I3"], p["Rf"]
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15

    # --- front CS device: DC Vx = Vg (no DC current in Rf) ---
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=max(m1.vgs, 0.2))
    vg1 = m1.vgs
    vx = vg1

    # --- PMOS load (mirror) ---
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I1, vds=1.8 - vx)

    # --- PMOS follower, bulk = own source (no body effect) ---
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I3, vds=1.3)
    vo = vx + m3.vgs
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I3, vds=max(vo, 0.3))
    vo = vx + m3.vgs
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I3, vds=max(1.8 - vo, 0.15))

    # --- bias: IREF -> NMOS diode -> NMOS mirror (Ib) -> PMOS diode ---
    mp0 = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], Ib, vds=m2.vgs)
    mn0 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.65)
    mn0 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=mn0.vgs)
    mn1 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, Ib, vds=max(1.8 - mp0.vgs, 0.2))

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "x", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.R("RF", "x", "iin", Rf)
    n.dev("M3", "vss", "x", "vout", "vout", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp0)
    n.dev("MN0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn0)
    n.dev("MN1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn1)

    # --- small-signal prediction (2-node loop + follower) ---
    gm1 = m1.gm
    Go = m1.gds + m2.gds
    Cf = m1.cgd
    Cg = cpd + (m1.cgg - m1.cgd)
    gsf = m3.gm + m3.gds + m4.gds
    asf = m3.gm / gsf
    cgs3 = max(m3.cgg - m3.cgd, 0.0)
    Cx = m1.cdd + m2.cdd + m3.cgd + cgs3 * (1 - asf)
    Co = cl + m4.cdd + cgs3 * 0.3

    f = np.logspace(4, 10, 3000)
    s = 1j * 2 * PI * f
    Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
    # node eqs: i = vg*(sCg+Yf) - vx*Yf ; 0 = gm1*vg + vx*(Go+sCx+Yf) - vg*Yf
    a = (Go + s * Cx + Yf) / (Yf - gm1)
    vx_over_i = 1.0 / (a * (s * Cg + Yf) - Yf)
    Hsf = m3.gm / (gsf + s * Co)
    Zt = np.abs(vx_over_i * Hsf)
    z0 = Zt[0]
    idx = np.where(Zt < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = float(f[idx[0]]) if len(idx) else float(f[-1])

    # --- noise at 1 MHz (referred to iin) ---
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    en2 = 4 * kT * 1.0 * (gm1 + m2.gm) / gm1**2
    ytot = abs(1.0 / Rf + 1j * w * (Cg + Cf))
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf + en2 * ytot**2
    in_noise = math.sqrt(in2)

    power = 1.8 * (iref + Ib + I1 + I3)
    A = gm1 / (Go + 1.0 / Rf)

    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": db(z0),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "power": power,
        "in_noise_1m": in_noise,
        "vout_dc": vo,
        "A_core": A,
        "Cx_fF": Cx * 1e15,
        "vg_dc": vg1,
    }
